<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that forms an ester (the target is a methyl ester) from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol. This will allow a one‑step synthesis using a commercially available acid and methanol.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid", "alcohol"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ester"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
